html:
Honduras is a country in the middle of Central America, with a long Caribbean coast and a short stretch on the Pacific. It has been a separate republic since 1838.

In the west lay Copán, one of the great cities of the Maya. Spain conquered the land in the 1520s and mined silver around Tegucigalpa. After independence in 1821 Honduras joined the Federal Republic of Central America, whose leading champion, Francisco Morazán, was a Honduran. It left when the federation broke up.

In the years the map shows from 1880, bananas took over:

  • American fruit companies, above all the United Fruit Company, got huge land grants on the north coast and ran railways and ports.
  • The writer O. Henry, who lived there for a time, coined the phrase "banana republic" with Honduras in mind.
  • US Marines landed several times in the early 1900s to protect American interests.

Tiburcio Carías ruled as dictator from 1933 to 1949. In 1969 Honduras fought the Football War with El Salvador. In the 1980s it was the base for the American-backed Contras fighting the government of Nicaragua. Hurricane Mitch in 1998 killed thousands and wrecked much of the country. In 2009 the army removed President Manuel Zelaya in a coup. Poverty and gang violence have driven many Hondurans to emigrate north.
sum: Honduras is a country in the middle of Central America, with a long Caribbean coast and a short stretch on the Pacific. It has been a separate republic since 1838.
